description: List bookShelving records across all accounts, newest first. This is the network-wide activity read: what has been put on a shelf lately, regardless of whose shelf it is. Ordered by the record's own recency, not by shelf, so a client can show a live feed without scanning individual repos.

limit.description: Maximum number of bookShelving records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; absent when no further shelving is known.
